literal_meaning: অনুকরণমূলক শব্দ যা ছোটখাটো ঝগড়া বা আঁচড়ানোর শব্দ নির্দেশ করে (onomatopoeic for petty scratching or bickering sounds)
figurative_meaning_en: Mutual jealousy and rivalry; bickering; petty quarrels
example_sentences_in_bangla: ভাই-বোনদের মধ্যে আকচাআকচি দেখে মা দুঃখ পান।
example_sentences_in_english: There's always bickering in the household.
The mother feels sad seeing the bickering between her brothers and sisters.
note: The idiom is onomatopoeic, mimicking sounds of petty fights; variants reflect regional pronunciations in Bengali dialects.
